title: Restore CLI compatibility with Kanbus Click requirement
description:
As a Tactus CLI user, I want the locked Typer and Click versions to be compatible, so that CLI commands and the full release gate execute successfully.

Feature: Compatible CLI dependency stack
Scenario: Invoke a Typer CLI command
Given Kanbus requires Click 8.3.1
When the Tactus CLI parses a command
Then Typer accepts Click's current metavar calling convention
And existing CLI tests pass.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Full release gate reproduced 35 CLI failures on current develop with Typer 0.12.5 and Click 8.3.1. The failure is TyperArgument.make_metavar receiving Click's new context argument. Click cannot be downgraded because Kanbus 0.18.3 requires 8.3.1; the narrow repair is to move Tactus to a Typer release supporting Click 8.3 and rerun the CLI and full gates.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Upgraded Typer to the Click 8.3-compatible 0.20 series. All 337 CLI tests and the complete Tactus unit and BDD gates pass.
